product.description: Monoprice™USB‑C® to 8K60 HDMI® 2.1 Adapter ‑ Ultra HD Display Solution for Creators, Gamers, and ProfessionalsCompact 8K Adapter Converts Your USB‑C Output to HDMI 2.1 for Ultra‑High Resolution DisplaysExperience the brilliance of next‑generation displays with the Monoprice USB‑C to 8K60 HDMI 2.1 Adapter‑a true game‑changer for creators, gamers, and professionals who demand premium performance. This sleek, ultra‑compact adapter unlocks ultra‑high‑definition visuals on any USB‑C‑enabled device, transforming your laptop, tablet, or smartphone into an 8K powerhouse.Enjoy breathtaking clarity and vibrant colors with support for up to 8K resolution at 60Hz and Dynamic HDR10+, ensuring every detail pops with lifelike realism. Engineered for versatility, the adapter offers seamless compatibility with MacBook Pro®/Air®, iPad®, iPhone® 15/16, and most Windows® USB‑C laptops equipped with DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode. Advanced HDMI 2.1 technology provides ultra‑fast, reliable transmission, while immersive 3D audio supports up to 16 channels‑creating a cinematic soundstage for every experience.Benefit from flexible color and audio support, including 8‑, 10‑, and 12‑bit color depths; multiple pixel formats (RGB, YCbCr 4:4:4, 4:2:2, 4:2:0); and pristine high‑resolution audio formats such as LPCM and HBR. Setup is effortless with the plug‑and‑play reversible USB‑C connector and automatic hot plug detection, making it easy to upgrade your workspace or entertainment system in seconds.Backed by Monoprice's renowned quality assurance, a 1‑year limited warranty, and FCC certification, this adapter is your passport to a world of ultra‑HD excellence.
